verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a Stats API (/api/v2/query, which handles simple and complex queries) and an Events API for recording pageviews and custom events, so stats reading and ingestion are scriptable. However, the Stats API is explicitly read-only, and nothing shows API access to the many UI-managed features: goals, funnels, annotations, shared links, team roles, imports/exports, reports and site settings. Missing for 10: write/management API for sites, goals, funnels, annotations, shared links and team members; documented UI-to-API parity; OpenAPI spec (probes 404).
